title: The right rail shows a clickable map of the events around the member, which opens the list-plus-map pop up in place

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-18 in the project chat: put a clickable events map of what's around the person in the right rail; a quick event pop up with the list on the left and the map on the right; we already have some styles like this set.

detail: The Events page already had the map door and the list-plus-map lightbox (SCAN-975), but only on /events. The right rail now carries an Around you panel on every member page: the same map tile at the rail's width, showing where the nearby events fall and how many there are, and a tap opens the same lightbox over the current page (search, When, Sort and category chips, the results list on the left and the live map on the right, the map on top on a phone; Back or Escape closes it). Nothing loads until the panel nears the viewport; then one server read, the Events page's own (getEventsIndexData with no filters), kept for the visit. Pins stay privacy-safe (a Circle event on its Circle's city point, ADR-186) and nothing goes to a pixel. On /events the panel stands down, so there is one map per page. The tile and lightbox styles move from members-events.css to their own events-map.css so the rail does not load the whole Events sheet. Tokens only. DAWN is unchanged.
